worldcombat.skill.recover.summary: The user regenerates its cells: health is paid back tick by tick over a window for about half of maximum health, more of it the worse the wounds - and it never locks the user in place, so it can keep moving while it heals. Clearing the regenerating identity cuts the remaining healing.
worldcombat.skill.recover.use.1: Let the cells work harder when badly hurt
worldcombat.skill.recover.use.2: Trade an unlocked window for a steady restore
worldcombat.skill.recover.description.0: Restores %1$s of maximum health, paid tick by tick across a %2$s window; reaching full health settles early.
worldcombat.skill.recover.description.1: About %1$s motes of light rise during the window with a %2$s-block glow, wider on a larger body.
worldcombat.skill.recover.description.2: Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s, shortened by Speed; the whole window can be walked through.
worldcombat.skill.recover.stance.steady: Steady regeneration: +0.05 healing and a 1.35x window - slower each tick but a larger total, at the cost of a longer cooldown and a longer exposed window.
worldcombat.skill.recover.stance.quick: Swift regeneration: -0.04 healing and a 0.75x window - faster to pay out with a shorter cooldown, for a gap between blows.
worldcombat.skill.recover.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.recover.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.recover.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.recover.preference.ste: On (steady): +0.05 healing and a 1.35x regeneration window (slower each tick, larger total), at 1.08x cooldown and a longer exposed window. Off (swift): -0.04 healing, a 0.75x window and 0.95x cooldown.
The companion starts regenerating below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher regenerates at the first wound.
